Stage 3 · Grammar

Grammar

my / your / his / her + Anna's
PersonPossessiveExample
ImyThis is my mother.
youyourThis is your brother.
hehisThis is his sister.
sheherThis is her father.
weourThis is our family.
theytheirThis is their son.
  • my / your / his / her / our / their go before the person: my mother.
  • he → his (a man's). she → her (a woman's).
  • Anna's mother = the mother of Anna. Add 's to the name.
  • It uses to be: She is my sister. (She's my sister.)

→ this / that for things comes in Lesson 10.

🔧 Build it yourself
  • 🔧 Build it yourself
  • Build it: Anna + phone → Anna'S phone. My/your/his/her never change: my sister, his car.
  • ⚠ His = его (owner is a man), her = её (owner is a woman). Match the OWNER, not the thing.

Stage 6 · Speaking

Your turn

Write two short lines about your family.

When you finish, open the model answer and check yourself.

Model answer

This is my family. This is my mother, Sara. She is kind. This is my brother, Tom.

Check yourself:

  • Did you use This is my …?
  • Did you name a family member (mother, brother…)?
  • Is to be correct? (She is / He's)
Talk to Sam. Answer with the words from this lesson.

Read each message. Tap 🔊 to hear Sam.

Sam

Hi! I'm Sam. 👋

Sam

This is my family. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦

Sam

Who is in your family?

Sam

Nice! 🙂

Sam

Anna is my sister. Listen: I say “This is his phone.” 🤔

Why

Anna is a girl (she) → her. his is for a man (he).

Sam

Yes! “Her phone.” Great catch. 🌟

Feedback

Well done: you talked about your family and fixed his/her. Next time, say a family sentence out loud too.
